description: Vietnam's large-value cash transaction report, evaluated per customer and business day on the day's cash deposits and withdrawals, VND and foreign currency converted to VND. Threshold of Decision 11/2023/QD-TTg (400,000,000 VND or the equivalent, from 1 December 2023, replacing the 300,000,000 VND of Decision 20/2013/QD-TTg); deadline of Article 37(1) of the Anti-Money Laundering Law 14/2022/QH15 (one working day, filed electronically). Whether deposits and withdrawals are summed together is to be confirmed against the official gazette and Circular 27/2025/TT-NHNN; this table sums them, which reports more rather than less

rules.description: Cash deposited and withdrawn by one customer in one day comes to 400,000,000 VND or more
